t: A Raspberry Pi Pico kit with pre-connected sensors for MicroPython and CircuitPython.
steps: Find the Edu Pico kit at Cytron or a distributor such as DigiKey.
Check stock and price before ordering.
Connect the board to a computer by USB.
Install a code editor that works with MicroPython or CircuitPython.
Load a first program that reads a sensor.
Try the Grove connectors with an extra module.
Test one board before buying a class set.
